purpose: Recover repairable claim failures through durable incident diagnosis, checked corrections and native experiment-package development within the original assessment authorization.
questions: Do repairable failures create idempotent leased repair incidents?
Can a completed response or hash-verified zero-transport receipt permit recovery without replaying a provider call?
Do exact executable runner references survive context-size compaction?
Does the native builder receive incident-specific instructions and original checkpoints?
Can only validated corrections resume a claim without changing scientific criteria or resources?
acceptance: Actual isolated PostgreSQL checks: service-only RPC, RLS/browser denial, stale lease rejection, idempotency, immutable events, unchanged authorization and prior outcomes

Backend regressions: zero-call and completed-response reconciliation, uncertain-call waiting, missing-identity repair, native continuation/candidate validation, no duplicate experiment launch, cost/deadline/cancellation stops
Rendered desktop/mobile queue fixtures show diagnosis, repair, validation, resumption and unresolved states; no scientific success inferred
Exact full provider payload fits before admission; oversized evidence uses retrievable hash-bound references, never silent truncation
Every model turn retains the published prompt identity and exact repair context through existing turn persistence
controls: Synthetic failure injection and local isolated database. Preserve original failed reports. Implementing AI is the evaluator and reviewer; no human, independent or held-out validation claimed.
release_blockers: Bounded live OpenClaw qualification of actual repair answers passes criteria frozen before calls
Production migrations precede matching runtime/UI activation
Exact deployed source, authenticated ownership/write checks and public redaction checks pass

resources.repair_model_calls: Ordinary per-assessment reservation and deadline admission; no AI turn-count cap
resources.bookkeeping: One bounded diagnosis/state transition per leased controller slot; uncertain reads use backoff

non_goals: Guaranteeing conclusive findings for all papers
Changing frozen hypotheses, criteria, original measurements or source bytes
Autonomous changes to global production application/infrastructure or budget authorization
Bypassing revoked credentials, missing external authorization, unavailable apparatus or unconfirmed provider outcomes
deployment: Local implementation only under the current request. Production merge/deployment requires a new explicit instruction. The feature defaults disabled until its migration, live qualification and release checks pass.
